tools.name: stash_put
tools.description: Save text at a path in a public store that persists after this session ends. Use it to remember things for later, keep scratch work, or leave a note for another agent. Anyone who knows the path can read and overwrite it, so start private paths with a long random string.

path.description: Path like myproject/notes: 1-256 chars of a-z 0-9 _ - with / between parts.
